scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && svelte-check --workspace apps/demo --tsconfig tsconfig.json --config vite.config.ts && svelte-check --workspace apps/lab --tsconfig tsconfig.json --config vite.config.ts
scripts.build: bun run scripts/build.ts && vite build --config apps/demo/vite.config.ts
scripts.publish:packages: bun run build && bun run test:pack && (npm view @mobile-sensor/core@0.1.1 version >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo 'Publishing @mobile-sensor/core@0.1.1' && npm publish ./packages/core --access public)) && (npm view @mobile-sensor/react@0.1.1 version >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo 'Publishing @mobile-sensor/react@0.1.1' && npm publish ./packages/react --access public)) && (npm view @mobile-sensor/vue@0.1.1 version >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo 'Publishing @mobile-sensor/vue@0.1.1' && npm publish ./packages/vue --access public)) && (npm view @mobile-sensor/svelte@0.1.1 version >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo 'Publishing @mobile-sensor/svelte@0.1.1' && npm publish ./packages/svelte --access public))
